title: Implement a retry decorator in Python
description: Implement a @retry(times, exceptions) decorator that retries a function on specified exceptions up to a maximum number of attempts.

files.src/retry.py:
from functools import wraps

def retry(times: int, exceptions: tuple = (Exception,)):
    """Decorator that retries the function up to `times` on `exceptions`."""
    raise NotImplementedError

task_spec.prompt:
Implement the `retry` decorator in src/retry.py:
- `retry(times, exceptions)` returns a decorator
- The decorator wraps the function: on each call, attempt up to `times` tries
- On each attempt, call the wrapped function; if it raises one of `exceptions`, retry
- After exhausting all attempts, re-raise the last exception
- If the function succeeds, return its value immediately
- Use `@wraps(fn)` to preserve metadata
